Marta Ruiz: found a 404 in the private deploy guideKMS connector section. the pkcs11 tutorial link goes to a deleted page. opened PR to replace with internal mirror + add a short migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432
Evan Chen: nice catch. can you also add a simple SDK snippet for Go and Python showing how to set PKCS11 module path + token label? folks keep getting 'no module' errors.
Marta Ruiz: adding short snippets. Go example:
```go
conf := &kms.Config{
  PKCS11Module: "/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so",
  TokenLabel:   "RedwoodHSM",
}
client, err := kms.New(conf)
```
and Python:
```py
from redwood_kms import PKCS11Config
conf = PKCS11Config(module_path='/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so', token_label='RedwoodHSM')
client = PKCS11Client(conf)
```
Priya Shah: please add a quick permission checklist. common customer report: "open session" fails with permission denied or CKR_GENERAL_ERROR when /dev/hsm0 owned by root:root. include `ls -l /dev/hsm0` and recommended udev rule + systemd tmpfiles snippet.
Evan Chen: also call out SELinux. on RHEL systems we saw AVC denials: `avc:  denied  { open } for  pid=`. add audit2allow hint and a minimal sepolicy note (but warn that customers must vet).
Marta Ruiz: will include both. udev example:
```bash
# /etc/udev/rules.d/99-hsm.rules
KERNEL==\"hsm0\", SUBSYSTEM==\"char\", MODE=\"0660\", GROUP=\"hsm\", OWNER=\"root\"
```
And tmpfiles for persistent device group:
```text
# /etc/tmpfiles.d/hsm.conf
L+ /dev/hsm0 - - - - /dev/hsm0
```
Evan Chen: small tweak: tmpfiles entry above is non-typical; maybe just a short note to create a symlink if installer expects /var/run/hsm. Include: `ln -s /dev/hsm0 /var/run/hsm` as migration step.
Priya Shah: posting a real log that prompted this: 
```text
2026-03-01T08:12:05Z kms: pkcs11: OpenSession() failed: CKR_GENERAL_ERROR
2026-03-01T08:12:05Z system: stat /dev/hsm0 -> -rw------- 1 root root
2026-03-01T08:12:06Z audit: type=AVC msg=audit(1677654725.123:45): avc:  denied  { open } for  pid=2345 comm=\"redwood-kms\" scontext=system_u:system_r:init_t:s0 tcontext=unconfined_u:object_r:device_t:s0 tclass=chr_file
```
Priya Shah: fix was adding node to hsm group + `chgrp hsm /dev/hsm0 && chmod 660 /dev/hsm0` and adding a simple local sepolicy module using audit2allow. i'll add a short warning and point to enterprise security review.
Marta Ruiz: added an "HSM permissions & SELinux" subsection and updated TOC. also updated the broken link to the internal mirror and left a note to upstream the tutorial link once it's restored.
Evan Chen: add a tiny `openssl s_client -connect kms.internal:443 -showcerts` snippet for TLS chain debug; customers forget to include intermediate CA.
Marta Ruiz: included that plus a one-liner to add CA to debian/ubuntu trust: `sudo cp customer.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ && sudo update-ca-certificates`.
